_comment: Editorial All-Area teams, keyed by sport then season (data/all_area.json → #/<sport>/all-area). The frontend shows the newest entry for the sport whose `published` date (YYYY-MM-DD, local) has arrived; until then the page shows 'The All-Area team is announced after the state tournament.' Keys that start with an underscore are ignored. Player entries: { player_name, school_id, position?, year?, line? } — the name links to the player page when that player has stat lines this season, otherwise it renders as plain text. coach_of_year: { name, school_id, line? }. sponsor_slot names the data/sponsors.json slot that runs under the title (default 'all-area'). See docs/all-area.md.
